Definition: to go away, hence, to disappear
BiblicalUsage: 1) to go, to go away, to go about; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to go away; 1a2) to go about; 1a3) to be used up, be exhausted, be gone, evaporated; 1b) (Pual) to go to and fro
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
